idea-plugin.name: Open Existing Clone
idea-plugin.description:
Detects repositories that were already cloned locally.
Adds a Local (本地已有) tab to the Get from Version Control dialog and a File | Open Existing Clone… action: paste a repository URL, and if a local clone exists it is opened (and added to recent projects) instead of cloning again.

action.description: Open the Get from Version Control dialog with Git (Open Existing) preselected
